subject: Re: Legal requirements and cost-sharing model for compliance add-ons
messages:
-----Original Message-----
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@bluehorizonlabs.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance add-ons: scope + amortization options

Rohan,

Thanks for the demo yesterday. BlueHorizon is interested in Redwood but we have a few outstanding questions on the compliance add-ons before procurement moves forward.

Quick list:
- Audit logs: pricing for 30/90/365‑day retention; can you confirm per‑event billing and any caps?
- KMS/HSM: do you charge per-region or per‑customer? Any separate hardware pass‑throughs?
- Data residency: EU vs US pricing differential (we need EU residency for a new product line)
- One‑time onboarding/professional services fee: can this be amortized across the contract term or taken as a credit?

Procurement requested your SOC 2 Type II summary and a KMS/HSM architecture diagram to attach to the PO. Targeting a signed PO by end of March if terms acceptable.

I've attached our initial RFI (Initial_RFI_questions.xlsx).

Regards,
Elena Torres
Head of Cloud Ops
BlueHorizon Labs

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@bluehorizonlabs.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 13 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons: scope + amortization options

Elena —

Appreciate the clear list. Below is a concise proposal to unblock procurement; happy to iterate.

Pricing sketch (US region):
- Audit logs: tiered retention pricing per 100k events / month: 30d = $125, 90d = $250, 365d = $700.
  - Optional cap: 1M events / month at 10% additional discount.
- KMS: managed KMS (per-key) included in base API for primary region; HSM-backed KMS (FIPS) is an add-on: $3,500/month per region for the HSM cluster (first region) + $1,200/month for subsequent regions.
- One‑time onboarding / PS: $25k standard.

Amortization / credit options we can offer:
Option 1 (24m commit): We can amortize the $25k fee across 24 months as a monthly credit and provide a 15% discount on compliance add-ons year 1.
Option 2 (36m commit): Amortize across 36 months and increase discount to 20% year 1, with a one‑time $10k onboarding credit applied at signing.

For HSM costs: we can split the first year's HSM region charge 50/50 as a one‑time concession if BlueHorizon commits to 24 months.

I've attached a short summary PDF (proposal-summary.pdf) and created a HubSpot deal record for reference (link below). If you want, Priya can prepare a counteroffer doc with explicit line items for legal.

Next step: confirm which amortization horizon you prefer and whether EU residency should have HSM included in the base or remain an add‑on.

Best,
Rohan Mehta
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@bluehorizonlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 13 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons: scope + amortization options

Looping in potential deal structures so legal/procurement have concrete options.

Proposal A (flexible):
- 12 month term; no onboarding amortization; standard pricing for audit logs/KMS/HSM; no discounts.
- Good if you want minimal term commitment.

Proposal B (committed):
- 24 month commit: $25k onboarding amortized monthly; 15% off compliance add-ons Y1; HSM first region 50/50 split Y1; optional EU residency at +15% premium.

Proposal C (enterprise):
- 36 month commit: $25k onboarding amortized over 36 months + $10k signing credit at execution; 20% off compliance add-ons Y1; HSM first region covered by Redwood for the first 12 months (we absorb hardware OPEX cost, not capital).

Notes:
- Legal will need to confirm the wording on indemnities/return of keys for cross-region keys.
- If BlueHorizon needs KMS included in base for EU, we will need an addendum for cross-border key handling and a modest uplift.

Attaching a pricing spreadsheet (deal-pricing-sheet.xlsx). Approve if you'd like us to send Proposal B or C as a formal counter.

Thanks,
Priya
Account Manager
-----Original Message-----
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@bluehorizonlabs.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons: scope + amortization options

Rohan / Priya,

Thanks — some follow up from procurement and engineering:

1) Amortization: procurement prefers a 36-month amortization. They will accept a smaller signing credit in exchange.
2) KMS/EU: engineering requests that KMS functionality for EU residency be included in the base price for the first EU region; they will accept an uplift on the committed spend rather than a per-region HSM line item.
3) HSM multi-region: we need HSM in EU + US from day one. Can Redwood provide a multi-region bundle price rather than per-region engineering pass‑throughs?
4) Evidence: please provide SOC2 Type II and a short KMS architecture diagram (required for our security assessment) — we cannot move to PO without those.

Procurement timeline: PO by 2027-03-31 if terms align. I attached our PO template/questions (PO_RFI.pdf).

Elena

On a separate note, can you confirm whether SLA credits for availability affect compliance add-on costs or are separate?

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@bluehorizonlabs.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons: scope + amortization options

Elena —

Thanks for the clear asks. Two quick answers and an updated concession set.

Evidence:
- SOC 2 Type II executive summary attached (SOC2_summary.pdf).
- KMS/HSM architecture diagram available here: https://drive.redwood.com/hsm-architecture/diagram (we can export a redacted copy for your security team).

Commercial concessions we can commit to if BlueHorizon signs a 36‑month SOW by 2027‑03‑31:
- We will amortize onboarding over 36 months and apply a $7,500 signing credit at execution.
- We will include KMS features required for EU residency in the base for the first EU region (subject to data transfer annex). This removes the per‑region KMS charge you noted.
- For HSM: Redwood will provide a multi‑region bundle rate: $4,200/month total for US+EU HSM coverage (reduced from $4,700 list for two regions). This pricing is a discounted bundle for the first 12 months; after Y1 list regional rates apply.
- We will issue a one‑time $10k waiver of the professional services onboarding fee (reduces the effective onboarding from $25k to $15k) if the 36m SOW is executed.

SLA credits: availability SLA credits are separate from compliance add-on pricing; however, we will include a 10% service credit on compliance add-ons for the first year if availability drops below the agreed SLOs.

I'll ask Legal to draft the addendum for EU residency language and the key-handling clauses; expect their note tomorrow. If those terms work, Rohan/Priya can generate the counteroffer and DocuSign packet.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
